{{Top|leg}}
'''Yifaii''' was a [[Ssi-ruu]] who participated in his [[Species/Legends|species]]' forays into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search for subjects for the [[entechment]] process. During this time, he served as [[Entechment Chief]] and [[Firwirrung]] served as his assistant. This fleet was responsible for a raid against the planet [[G'rho]] where [[Dev Sibwarra]] was captured. The [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] was not enteched and [[Unit Commander]] [[Th'twirirl]] passed the [[Human/Legends|Human]] child to Firwirrung.
